---
title: "Revised NHANES Plot"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  message: false
---
```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(survey)

options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
candidate_paths <- c(
  "nhanes_equity_v6.csv",
  "data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv",
  "examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv",
  "../../../examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv"
)

data_path <- candidate_paths[file.exists(candidate_paths)][1]
if (is.na(data_path)) {
  stop("Could not find nhanes_equity_v6.csv relative to ", getwd())
}

nhanes_raw <- read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: config
outcome    <- "obesity"     # "obesity" (BMI >= 30 prevalence) or "bmi" (mean BMI)

col_age    <- "Age"         # NHANES: RIDAGEYR
col_weight <- "WTMEC2YR"    # exam weight; 2017-March 2020 uses WTMECPRP
col_strata <- "SDMVSTRA"
col_psu    <- "SDMVPSU"

income_levels <- NULL       # e.g. c("Low", "Middle", "High"); NULL = sorted unique
cycle_levels  <- NULL       # e.g. c("1999-2000", ..., "2017-March 2020")

# 2000 US standard population, adult age groups used by NCHS obesity reports
std_pop <- c("20-39" = 0.3966, "40-59" = 0.3718, "60+" = 0.2316)
```

```{r}
#| label: estimates
required <- c("Cycle", "IncomeGroup", "BMI", col_age)
missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(nhanes_raw))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

has_design <- all(c(col_weight, col_strata, col_psu) %in% names(nhanes_raw))
if (!has_design) {
  warning("Survey design columns not found; using UNWEIGHTED, age-standardized estimates.")
}

if (is.null(cycle_levels))  cycle_levels  <- sort(unique(nhanes_raw$Cycle))
if (is.null(income_levels)) income_levels <- sort(unique(na.omit(nhanes_raw$IncomeGroup)))

nhanes <- nhanes_raw |>
  mutate(
    Age         = .data[[col_age]],
    Cycle       = factor(Cycle, levels = cycle_levels),
    IncomeGroup = factor(IncomeGroup, levels = income_levels, ordered = TRUE),
    AgeGroup    = cut(Age, breaks = c(20, 40, 60, Inf), right = FALSE,
                      labels = names(std_pop)),
    Obese       = as.numeric(BMI >= 30),
    in_analysis = !is.na(Age) & Age >= 20 & !is.na(BMI) &
                  !is.na(IncomeGroup) & !is.na(Cycle)
  )

value_var <- if (outcome == "obesity") "Obese" else "BMI"

if (has_design) {
  design_data <- nhanes |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[col_weight]]), .data[[col_weight]] > 0,
           !is.na(.data[[col_strata]]), !is.na(.data[[col_psu]]))

  des <- svydesign(
    ids     = as.formula(paste0("~", col_psu)),
    strata  = as.formula(paste0("~", col_strata)),
    weights = as.formula(paste0("~", col_weight)),
    nest    = TRUE,
    data    = design_data
  )

  des_std <- svystandardize(
    subset(des, in_analysis),
    by = ~AgeGroup, over = ~Cycle + IncomeGroup, population = std_pop
  )

  est <- svyby(as.formula(paste0("~", value_var)),
               ~Cycle + IncomeGroup, des_std, svymean, na.rm = TRUE) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    rename(estimate = all_of(value_var))

  method_note <- "Survey-weighted, age-standardized to the 2000 US standard population; bars are 95% CIs."
} else {
  est <- nhanes |>
    filter(in_analysis) |>
    group_by(Cycle, IncomeGroup, AgeGroup) |>
    summarise(m = mean(.data[[value_var]]),
              v = var(.data[[value_var]]) / n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(w = std_pop[as.character(AgeGroup)]) |>
    group_by(Cycle, IncomeGroup) |>
    summarise(estimate = sum(w * m) / sum(w),
              se       = sqrt(sum(w^2 * v, na.rm = TRUE)) / sum(w),
              .groups  = "drop")

  method_note <- "UNWEIGHTED (not nationally representative), age-standardized; bars are approximate 95% CIs."
}

est <- est |>
  mutate(lower = estimate - 1.96 * se, upper = estimate + 1.96 * se)

if (outcome == "obesity") {
  est <- est |> mutate(lower = pmax(lower, 0), upper = pmin(upper, 1))
}

period <- paste(range(as.character(levels(droplevels(est$Cycle)))), collapse = " to ")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-revised
#| fig-cap: "Revised plot: survey-weighted, age-standardized estimates with 95% confidence intervals."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5.5
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.4)

y_label <- if (outcome == "obesity") "Obesity prevalence (BMI \u2265 30)" else "Mean BMI (kg/m\u00b2)"
title   <- if (outcome == "obesity") "Adult obesity prevalence by income group" else "Mean adult BMI by income group"

revised_plot <- ggplot(
  est,
  aes(x = Cycle, y = estimate, color = IncomeGroup, group = IncomeGroup)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, position = dodge) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.15, position = dodge) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, position = dodge) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma", end = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title    = title,
    subtitle = paste0("US adults age 20+, NHANES ", period),
    x        = "NHANES cycle",
    y        = y_label,
    color    = "Income group",
    caption  = paste(method_note,
                     "Cross-sectional data: differences are associations, not causal effects.",
                     sep = "\n")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.caption    = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, color = "grey30")
  )

if (outcome == "obesity") {
  revised_plot <- revised_plot +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    expand_limits(y = 0)
}

revised_plot
```



```{r}
#| label: export-plot
#| include: false
dir.create("assignments/assignment05-visualization/output", recursive = TRUE,
           showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave("assignments/assignment05-visualization/output/revised-plot.png", revised_plot,
       width = 8, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
